svg.title: The packing list for deploy day
svg.desc: A leather strap hangs a luggage tag for each file in SQUIRE's packing list, one after another: build.sh, deployments/001-first-release.sh, scripts/release.sh, health.php, The parity kit (12 files). Each tag is stamped Packed. Then the satchel's own tag reads From my-app, Holds 16 files, and the counter says 5 of 5 packed, buckled for deploy day.
svg.text: The packing list for deploy day
